metadata.question: Was the sulfer dioxide concentration higher over Cumbre Vieja than the Funchal Island on October 18, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI for SO2 (sulfur dioxide) - Date: October 18, 2021 (single day) - Locations: Cumbre Vieja (La Palma volcano, Canary Islands) and Funchal (Madeira Island) 2. Masking strategy: - SO2 data typically has quality flags. Use qa_value >= 0.5 for good quality pixels - The question is about SO2 concentration, not clouds, so mask poor quality data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: SO2 = 0 or very low values are scientifically valid (no volcanic emission at that point) - C1: If no images exist for the date/location - C2: If images exist but all pixels are masked out - C3: If the result is None, NaN, or outside valid SO2 range (typically -0.1 to 1.0 mol/m²) - Compare: If Cumbre Vieja > Funchal, answer A; otherwise B ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions # Cumbre Vieja volcano on La Palma, Canary Islands (erupted Sept-Dec 2021) cumbre_vieja = ee.Geometry.Point([-17.8437, 28.5722]) # Funchal on Madeira Island funchal = ee.Geometry.Point([-16.9094, 32.6669]) date_start = '2021-10-18' date_end = '2021-10-19' # 2. Data Acquisition so2_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2') \ .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \ .select('SO2_column_number_density') # Check collection size col_size = so2_col.size().getInfo() print(f"SO2 Images found: {col_size}") if col_size == 0: print("No Sentinel-5P SO2 data for Oct 18, 2021") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Get mean image and apply quality mask so2_image = so2_col.mean() # Quality flag (qa_value >= 0.5 for good quality) qa_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2') \ .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \ .select('SO2_column_number_density_qa_value') qa_image = qa_col.mean() # Mask poor quality pixels so2_masked = so2_image.updateMask(qa_image.gte(0.5)) # 4. Calculation at both locations # Cumbre Vieja cumbre_stats = so2_masked.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=cumbre_vieja.buffer(5000), scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ) cumbre_so2 = cumbre_stats.get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo() cumbre_count = so2_masked.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=cumbre_vieja.buffer(5000), scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo() # Funchal funchal_stats = so2_masked.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=funchal.buffer(5000), scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ) funchal_so2 = funchal_stats.get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo() funchal_count = so2_masked.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=funchal.buffer(5000), scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo() # 5. Validation & Final Answer print(f"Cumbre Vieja SO2: {cumbre_so2}, Valid pixels: {cumbre_count}") print(f"Funchal SO2: {funchal_so2}, Valid pixels: {funchal_count}") if cumbre_count == 0 or funchal_count == 0: print("No valid pixels after quality masking") print("C2") elif cumbre_so2 is None or funchal_so2 is None: print("Calculation returned None") print("C3") elif cumbre_so2 < -0.1 or funchal_so2 < -0.1 or cumbre_so2 > 1.0 or funchal_so2 > 1.0: print("SO2 values outside valid range") print("C3") elif cumbre_so2 > funchal_so2: print("Cumbre Vieja SO2 concentration was higher than Funchal") print("A") else: print("Cumbre Vieja SO2 concentration was NOT higher than Funchal") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Cumbre Vieja volcano on La Palma, Canary Islands (erupted Sept-Dec 2021)
cumbre_vieja = ee.Geometry.Point([-17.8437, 28.5722])
# Funchal on Madeira Island
funchal = ee.Geometry.Point([-16.9094, 32.6669])

date_start = '2021-10-18'
date_end = '2021-10-19'

# 2. Data Acquisition
so2_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2') \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .select('SO2_column_number_density')

# Check collection size
col_size = so2_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"SO2 Images found: {col_size}")

if col_size == 0:
    print("No Sentinel-5P SO2 data for Oct 18, 2021")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Get mean image and apply quality mask
    so2_image = so2_col.mean()
    
    # Quality flag (qa_value >= 0.5 for good quality)
    qa_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2') \
        .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
        .select('SO2_column_number_density_qa_value')
    qa_image = qa_col.mean()
    
    # Mask poor quality pixels
    so2_masked = so2_image.updateMask(qa_image.gte(0.5))
    
    # 4. Calculation at both locations
    # Cumbre Vieja
    cumbre_stats = so2_masked.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=cumbre_vieja.buffer(5000),
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    cumbre_so2 = cumbre_stats.get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    cumbre_count = so2_masked.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=cumbre_vieja.buffer(5000),
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    # Funchal
    funchal_stats = so2_masked.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=funchal.buffer(5000),
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    funchal_so2 = funchal_stats.get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    funchal_count = so2_masked.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=funchal.buffer(5000),
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    print(f"Cumbre Vieja SO2: {cumbre_so2}, Valid pixels: {cumbre_count}")
    print(f"Funchal SO2: {funchal_so2}, Valid pixels: {funchal_count}")
    
    if cumbre_count == 0 or funchal_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after quality masking")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif cumbre_so2 is None or funchal_so2 is None:
        print("Calculation returned None")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif cumbre_so2 < -0.1 or funchal_so2 < -0.1 or cumbre_so2 > 1.0 or funchal_so2 > 1.0:
        print("SO2 values outside valid range")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif cumbre_so2 > funchal_so2:
        print("Cumbre Vieja SO2 concentration was higher than Funchal")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("Cumbre Vieja SO2 concentration was NOT higher than Funchal")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
